If you are siting a replacement, the state is the unit that matters: New York's median site has 10 years and Arizona's has 86, and permits are issued by the state.
847 landfills are drawn on the map and 15 territorial sites in the strip below it. The state medians use only sites computable in both editions, 15 to 42 of them per state.
Equal-area conic, standard parallels 29.5N and 45.5N. No boundary file is used: the state letters sit at the centroid of that state's own landfills.
